jurisdiction_sources.note: 16 V.S.A. section 603(a)(5)(F) inventory: Vernon Town School District, a town school district in the Windham Southeast Supervisory Union (member town: Vernon). Operates PK-6; tuitions secondary grades.
Windham Southeast SU -- Vernon School Board page (official).

board.post_note: Vernon SD: five directors at-large under 16 V.S.A. section 423(a)-(b) (three on 3-year terms, two on 2-year terms), elected by Australian ballot on Town Meeting Day.

sources.note: WSESU Vernon School Board members page (official, fetched 2026-10-22) with the Town of Vernon official results: March 3, 2026 -- Amidon elected to the 2-year seat (193 votes, uncontested) and write-in Julie Stoughton (51 votes, NAMED in the official results) elected to the remaining 2 years of a 3-year term (end 2028); the warned 3-year seat drew NO candidate and nobody was elected. Sept. 14, 2026 board minutes: "Appointing new board member -- Munson Hicks -- Motion by Julie, passed"; the Sept. 28, 2026 minutes show the full five seated (Amidon, Brown, Stoughton, Baldwin, Hicks) -- Hicks was appointed under section 424 to the seat that failed to elect (the members page's "Vacant Seat" entry is stale). March 4, 2025 results: Baldwin elected (309 votes, end 2027); Amidon seated that year by write-in to a 1-year seat. FLAG (Brown): her term end conflicts across three official sources -- FY2024 report 2025, WSESU members page 2027, FY2025 report 2028 -- and her seating across the 2025 boundary is undocumented; she is minted ELECTED with NO end (resolving documents: the board minutes and the March 2025 return detail). Stoughton's current seat rests on her 2026 write-in election; her 2025 seating on the prior seat implies an unrecorded section 424 appointment (minutes, March-June 2025). NOT minted: Kerry Amidon (term expired March 2026; her seat is the one that failed to elect), Walter Breau and Sarah/Sara Deyo (terms expired 2025).

directors.name: Daniel Amidon
directors.note: Board Chair; elected March 3, 2026 to the 2-year seat (official results: 193 votes).

directors.name: Katherine Baldwin
directors.note: Board Clerk (officer role not modeled); elected March 4, 2025 (official results: 309 votes). Minted under her full name; the roster styles her "Kat Baldwin."

directors.name: Julie Stoughton
directors.note: Write-in winner NAMED in the official March 3, 2026 results (51 votes) for the remaining 2 years of a 3-year term.

directors.name: Cheryl Brown
directors.note: Vice Chair. NO end minted -- her term end conflicts across three official sources (2025 / 2027 / 2028); see the flag in the board sources.

directors.name: Munson Hicks
directors.note: Appointed Sept. 14, 2026 (board minutes) under 16 V.S.A. section 424 to the 3-year seat that failed to elect in March 2026. No end stated (statutory endpoint is the next annual meeting; not minted as an end).
